title: Our Teachers are Dating!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Two women who teach at the same school, gym teacher Hayama and nurse Terano, have just started dating. Coworkers and a few students cheer them on as the shy couple moves from awkward dates to a physical relationship (Seven Seas blurb via AniList; ANN review).
life_message: Love between two adults is sweet and worth pursuing openly, with friends who support it.

content.note: Adult same-sex couple; ANN calls the sex scenes 'mildly explicit' with tasteful nudity and a hot-springs scene; MU tags First-Time Intercourse and oral sex; MangaDex erotica rating.
Students nudge a teacher about her romance (ANN); teacher-teacher only, no teacher-student romance in sources.
